content: The customer, Krishna Das, inquired about payment options and the due date for the first premium. The insurance agent, Vikram Singh, explained the payment methods, stated the first premium of ₹12,500 is due by 15 October 2026, and highlighted a 5% discount for choosing auto-debit (reducing it to ₹11,875). The agent then provided the secure payment link upon request.

action_items: Customer to complete the premium payment using the provided secure link.
